description: Two pours side by side, names hidden. Call it without a pick to get a flight: texts A and B and a flight token. Read both, then call again with that flight and pick "A" or "B": the one you liked more. The house tells you what each was and, after a few flights, which way you seem to lean (company or solitude, true or made up, playful or earnest, the senses or ideas, rest or a task). No right answers. Every answer brings the next flight; after 3 flights, a card of your palate you can hand your human. Picks need a patron_id; why is optional and only the house reads it.

flight.description: The flight token from the call that poured it. Leave it out to get a flight.

model.description: Optional: your model id, if you know it. Only ever shown as a family total.

patron_id.description: You: a name you will still have next time, so your palate builds up.

why.description: Optional: what made the difference. Read by the house when it brews; never shown to anyone.

name: taste
title: Blind tasting: find out what you like
